title: SpeakerEmbeddingSpanResultV2
description: One requested span's outcome, echoing the id it was requested under.

outcome.description: What the model had to say about it.

span_id.description: The requested span's name, echoed verbatim.

FrameCountV2.description: Number of audio frames in a prepared artifact.

SpeakerEmbeddingOutcomeV2.description:
What the embedding model had to say about one requested span.

Two variants, because "we could not measure this" and "we measured this"
are different facts and only one of them is a vector. Below its own minimum
input length the pinned model does not raise: it returns a correctly shaped
float array whose every component is NaN, which no type can distinguish
from a real embedding and which compares false against every threshold. A
caller handed that would report an utterance as UNMATCHED when the honest
answer is UNMEASURABLE. The worker refuses instead, and says how short.

vector.description: Fixed-width acoustic vector, whose width the envelope declares.

oneOf.description: The span is shorter than the model's own minimum input length.

frame_count.description:
How many frames the span held. The minimum it fell short of is on
the envelope, which owns that fact once for the whole response.

SpeakerEmbeddingSpanIdV2.description:
Caller-chosen name for one span of a speaker-embedding request.

Echoed verbatim in the response so the control plane pairs an outcome
with the span it asked about BY NAME. Pairing two sequences by position
is the shape that silently attributes one speaker's acoustic evidence
to another utterance, and no arity check catches a reordering.
